create.name: Deb Sheppard
create.bio:
Deb Sheppard is an American psychic medium and spiritual teacher who has given readings for more than twenty years. She found her way to the work during a hard period in her own life, when studying feng shui led her to sense relatives who had died, and she then taught herself about mediumship from library books. Soon after September 2001 she began reading for listeners on the radio station KOSI 101 and stayed for seventeen years. She describes herself as an empath who receives impressions through feeling as well as sight and sound, and she has been tested by several mediumship organisations, among them Helping Parents Heal and Bob Olson's directory, and by James Van Praagh.

Today she offers private mediumship, intuitive and past-life or Akashic Records readings by phone and Zoom, small online group readings and larger gallery events. As a teacher she puts the emphasis on helping people recognise signs from loved ones and trust their own intuition. Her recent courses, including The SOULution, a six-month group programme built on what she calls the Spiral Codes Method, look at recurring life patterns as lessons of the soul, and an earlier course explores soul contracts. She hosts the Spirited Straight Talk podcast and has written a book and an oracle deck on staying connected after loss.

courses.title: Readings with Deb
courses.description: Private sessions by phone or Zoom of 30 or 60 minutes: mediumship, intuitive guidance, a blend of both, or past lives and the Akashic Records. New appointments open at the start of each month.

courses.title: The SOULution
courses.description: A six-month online group programme that uses her Spiral Codes Method to look at the people, patterns, losses and longings in a life as soul lessons, with live sessions, recordings, reflection practices and a private community.

courses.title: Soul Contracts
courses.description: A self-paced online course on the idea that the soul chooses certain lessons before birth, with channelled teachings, meditations for meeting spirit guides and group support sessions.

free_resources.title: What Message Is Spirit Sending You Now?
free_resources.description: A short free quiz on her site that suggests a theme spirit may be pointing you towards, with a follow-up by email.
